# Attorney-Facing Medical Chronology Cleanliness Checklist

Use this checklist before delivering `MEDICAL_CHRONOLOGY.md`, `medical-chronology.html`, timeline PDF, master binder PDF, dashboard links, or a reviewed referral package.

## Must pass

- [ ] The visible chronology is titled and written as the client's medical chronology, not an agent/build report.
- [ ] No visible references to `fresh start pass`, `restart pass`, `inventoried`, `prior output`, prior failed outputs, source inventory counts, or agent process notes.
- [ ] Internal QC facts live only in `reports/` or internal review files, not on the attorney-facing chronology cards.
- [ ] Each card has Visit Summary first, then clinical details behind clear section labels or HTML accordions.
- [ ] Each card links to exactly one consolidated visit PDF unless a human specifically requested multiple source buttons for that row.
- [ ] Each consolidated visit PDF contains the pages for that date-of-service/provider encounter and is named `YYYY-MM-DD-provider-visit-title.pdf`.
- [ ] The binder is assembled as chronology first, then visit PDFs in chronology order.
- [ ] Dashboard shell/layout is preserved; chronology updates do not downgrade it to a plain Markdown fallback.

## Forbidden visible phrases to scan

- fresh start pass
- restart pass
- inventoried
- prior output
- source PDFs inventoried
- this rebuild
- agent pass
- review the linked packet
- go read the records
- verify from the linked

## Internal-only notes

It is fine for reports to mention duplicate productions, source inventory counts, page extraction methods, OCR limitations, and prior-output rejection. Keep those facts out of the attorney-facing chronology unless they are converted into a narrow source limitation in a clinical field.
